learning_objective: 🎯 Learn powerful spreadsheet analysis tools: Subtotals, What-If Analysis (Scenarios, Goal Seek, Solver), data consolidation, and automating tasks using Macros!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: समेकन / कई शीट्स के डेटा को जोड़ना
गोल सीक (वांछित परिणाम के लिए इनपुट खोजना)
परिदृश्य (भविष्य के अलग-अलग डेटा सेट सहेजना)
मैक्रो (कार्यों को रिकॉर्ड कर स्वचालित करना)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Consolidate combines data from multiple sheets into one master summary sheet. Subtotals automatically calculate group sums, averages, or counts within a sorted list.

Goal Seek works backward—if you know the target result of a formula, it calculates the input value needed to reach it. Solver is an advanced version that handles multiple changing variables and constraints.
Scenarios let you save and switch between different sets of input values (like 'Best Case', 'Worst Case', 'Expected Case') in the same worksheet to compare outcomes.
A Macro is a saved sequence of commands or keystrokes. You record a repetitive task once and run the macro to execute all steps instantly whenever needed.

fun_activity.title: 🎯 Goal Seek in Real Life
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you need a total score of 270 across 3 exams to get an A grade. You scored 85 in Math and 90 in Science (sum = 175). How many marks do you need in IT? Finding that exact 95 is how 'Goal Seek' works!

exam_tips: 📌 Differentiate clearly between Goal Seek (finds ONE unknown input for a target formula) and Solver (finds solutions using MULTIPLE inputs and constraints).
📌 Explain why data MUST be sorted by category before applying the 'Subtotal' command.
📌 Remember that Macros are recorded in a programming language called Basic / VBA.
quick_recap: ⭐ You can link cells between different worksheets and even completely different spreadsheet workbooks.
⭐ A hyperlink in a spreadsheet can point to a web page, an existing file, or a specific cell range.
⭐ Scenarios are non-destructive; switching between them does not delete your original worksheet formulas.
